privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.publicScope: Public browsing shows only the citizen-safe projection: ticket number, status, category, description, public address text, map coordinates approved for publication, department name when assigned, attribution display name, and approved public photo URLs.
privacy.internalRestriction: Internal ticket IDs, tracking codes from browse responses, contact details, private location precision, staff history, and private image keys are never shown on public surfaces.
privacy.trackingScope: Possession-based tracking requires your 6-character code and returns only the status timeline for that report.
